data.name: Beneath the Snow
data.detailed_description:
You know the way home.

You've walked it hundreds of times.

Tonight... something is different.

Beneath the Snow is a first-person psychological mystery set in a snow-covered Eastern European housing estate in the winter of 2003. Every block feels familiar, yet something is subtly wrong.

Cross underpasses, observe your surroundings, and decide which path belongs to reality. The smallest detail can change everything. If you make the wrong choice, you'll find yourself right where you started.

As the night grows colder, you'll uncover forgotten notes, encounter strange figures, and slowly piece together what lies beneath the snow.

Features

  • Explore a surreal, looping housing estate inspired by Eastern Europe.

  • Spot subtle environmental anomalies and choose the correct path forward.

  • Atmospheric psychological mystery with minimal dialogue and environmental storytelling.

  • Discover collectible notes that reveal fragments of the story.

  • Immersive sound design and haunting dreamlike soundtrack.

  • Stylized visuals blending modern lighting with a nostalgic pixel-inspired aesthetic.

Sometimes, the shortest way home...
isn't the right one.

data.short_description: One walk home becomes a journey through a fractured reality. Shift between two intertwined dimensions, where mirrors reveal another world, impossible spaces hide forgotten paths, and some routes only exist in the reflection.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 21H1 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (2 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB) — DirectX 11, Shader Model 5.0
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
